buyer: SERB Pharmaceuticals (via Perseus BidCo US, Inc.)

premium.basis: premium over unaffected stock price as cited by the Board

value_inflection_events.event: Announcement of definitive merger agreement with SERB Pharmaceuticals for $8.60 per share

details: No pre-deal rumors were identified; the deal followed confidential strategic discussions.
notes: The deal followed a five-month strategic review where initial asset-sale offers turned into a whole-company acquisition at a 105% premium, with the Board citing significant capital requirements for the RIT platform as a key reason for the sale.
